mainEntity.name: Should I paint the garage myself or hire a pro for the trim work too?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are choosing between DIY and hiring a professional, the biggest differences are prep quality, time, and finish consistency. Hiring a pro makes more sense when the trim needs repairs, the surfaces are heavily worn, or you want the project done faster with fewer mistakes.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY can work for simple touch-ups, but trim repairs and full garage repainting are usually better left to a pro. You get better prep, cleaner lines, and less chance of rework.
